records.subject: Welcome aboard, Granite Labs
records.body:
Hi Leo,

Thanks for setting up Granite Labs on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 0 (2026-09-02) but no invite and no key milestone by day 6; Wrenfield is teammate-centric, and no customer reply after welcome email [email:b4a21aaf] despite kickoff being held [calendar:b2cd7632]. Engagement exists but solo usage stalls; 8 days left gives modest odds.

draft.subject: Following up after our kickoff
draft.body:
Hi Leo,

Thanks for the time at our kickoff last week — good to hear how Granite Labs is planning to use Wrenfield. You've got your first project up, which is the main organizing unit, with tasks living inside them.

The next step that usually makes the difference is getting a teammate in alongside you. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you.

Best,
Nadia
